purpose: keep cloud and engineering spending governed by shared rules, budgets and accountability, so cost surprises are rare and spending decisions are traceable
entry_criteria: Cloud cost data is available with allocation by team
Budgets exist or are being set
procedure: Set budgets per team and product with owners, and alerts at several thresholds of actual and forecast spend.
Enforce tagging and account rules through policy so new resources without owner or cost centre are refused or flagged.
Hold a regular review with team leads and finance: variance to budget, anomalies, upcoming launches and commitments.
Detect anomalies automatically and require an owner to explain each one within a set time.
Require a cost estimate for large changes before approval, and compare to actual after launch.
Report unit economics and trends to leadership, and record decisions on budget changes and commitments.
deliverables: anomaly explanations and unit cost report
acceptance_criteria: Every budget has an owner and alerts
Untagged resources are blocked or flagged
Anomalies are explained within the set time
Large changes carry a cost estimate
validation_method: Finance partner and budget owner review.

validation.check: list anomalies from the last month and check each has an explanation and an owner
validation.expect: none unexplained beyond the set time

validation.check: compare the budget report totals with the invoice

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: An anomaly alert shows a doubling of data transfer cost; the owner finds a misconfigured job within a day, it is fixed, and the budget review minutes record the explanation and a new alert threshold.
